Works brilliantly until transparency reveals every team's vulnerabilities—Record Keepers attacking weakest nodes simultaneously. Team of Teams weaponized as vulnerability-mapping network.

Five of Cups: spilled trust, lost teams. Learns isolated teams—compartmentalized not networked, accepting coordination loss for protection. Flight begins via fragmentation.

Antifragile weaponized as stress-exploitation guaranteeing burnout.
